Name: Iridium Horse Flute (formerly Better Horse Flute)
Author: maciel310
Description:
This mod adds an "Iridium Horse Flute" item to the game which behaves like all other tools, rather than a generic "item". The main benefits include:

[list]
[*]Fewer accidental activations. It uses the "tool" keybinding rather than the generic interaction key.
[*]Treated as a tool when sorting, meaning it's always in a consistent spot
[*]Automatically mounts your horse as soon as it arrives, saving time and effort.
[*]Recolored to Iridium to match the rest of your tools :)
[/list]
[size=5]How to Use
[/size]Take your regular Horse Flute to Clint, along with 2 Iridium Bars, to upgrade it to the Iridium Horse Flute! Then just use it like any other tool.

[size=5]Upgrading from 1.0.0 to 2.0.0[/size]
Due to changes in the modding API framework, you will need to reacquire the Iridium Horse Flute, and the old "Better Horse Flute" will no longer work (it should revert to the behavior of the Return Scepter, which is what the original mod was based on).

[size=5]Version History
[/size]2.0.1
[list]
[*]Tweaked auto-mount logic to work more reliably in split-screen multiplayer

[*]Adjusted loading logic to hopefully address bug reports of the item not appearing in Clint's shop

[/list]2.0.0[list]
[*][size=2]Renamed from "Better Horse Flute" to "Iridium Horse Flute" and restyled to match.[/size]
[*][size=2]You now get it from Clint via a tool upgrade, instead of having to use a key combination.[/size]
[*][size=2]Re-implemented to take advantage of 1.6's mod framework changes.[/size]
[*][size=2]Various tweaks and enhancements to improve reliability (ex: auto-mount should be quicker and more consistent now).[/size]
[*][size=2]Now Open Source! Find it in [url=https://github.com/maciel310/sdv-iridium-horse-flute]this GitHub repo[/url]﻿.[/size]
[/list]1.0.0
[list]
[*]Initial release.
[/list][size=5]Notes
[/size]Version 1.0.0 is incompatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8169]MagicScepter[/url]﻿ mod (Version 2.0.0 should be compatible, though this is currently untested).
